# Blend › Blend Mode

**What belongs here.** The mix uses a blend mode instead of normal opacity.

**Examples.** additive film dissolve, difference

**Family test.** Is every pixel a weighted mix of A and B (or a flat colour), with no moving boundary?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
